title: Error
description: Every refusal of /api/boards/v1 (and of POST /grant): dispatch on `error`; `detail` is for a log. 401 unauthorized, 404 tournament_not_found, 409 pairing_gone / pairing_changed, 422 invalid_request / not_a_game, 429 rate_limited (with Retry-After), 401 invalid_grant on /grant. A desktop copy's network listener adds 404 not_found and 403 forbidden.
